title: Give the live root a neutral three-domain selector instead of an NBA-only redirect
problem_it_solves: Root index.html hard-redirects to docs/assurance/, so NFL and rental work is invisible to anyone who opens the published URL.
option_a: Neutral selector page listing NBA / NFL / SF rental with one-line evidence status
option_b: Keep the redirect, add a persistent top nav strip to every section
why_recommended: Lowest cost, no deletion, reversible in one commit; splitting the repo would break 6 open PRs and Pages paths.
prerequisites_before_implementing: No other session is editing index.html (checked via COORDINATION.md claims)

title: Declare one canonical NFL section and banner the other three as dated provenance
problem_it_solves: Four overlapping NFL dashboards make a reader choose between equally-stated tables with different snapshots.
option_a: Banner + link this decision desk as canonical, keep others read-only
option_b: Merge all four registers into one site and delete the sources
option_c: Leave as-is, add a comparison table
why_recommended: Non-destructive, preserves each session's evidence and CI history; merging risks losing the per-pack checkers that caught real defects.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Agreement from the owners of the other three sections (shared-output rule)

title: Schedule the four weekly official snapshot anchors (Wed/Thu/Fri reports + inactives)
problem_it_solves: Every pricing gate is blocked because the only official record is a single live read that changes under us.
option_a: GitHub Actions workflow writing dated, hashed CSVs to data/nfl_desk/snapshots/
option_b: Manual weekly read by the owner
why_recommended: Unlocks DG-04 and makes CLV and out-of-sample testable at zero licence cost; four weeks of data is enough to start.
prerequisites_before_implementing: No secrets needed; only public official pages, informational use

title: Assemble a licence-enquiry packet and store the answer in-repo either way
problem_it_solves: Q-01 blocks seven gates, and 'we asked' is not recorded anywhere.
option_a: Template enquiry to an official distribution partner; store the reply or refusal as JSON
option_b: Restrict the site to non-market outputs permanently and close the question
option_c: Continue with derived-from-official-scores lines only and label them as such
why_recommended: Turns an invisible blocker into a recorded decision; if refused, the site's scope becomes explicit rather than implied.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Owner authorisation to send an enquiry

title: Publish a machine-readable verified standings register and forbid re-typed numbers
problem_it_solves: Three packs re-enter the same 32 rows by hand, which is how a 24-21 game quietly changed league averages between them.
option_a: Single canonical CSV + generated views; every pack reads it
option_b: Per-pack copies with a cross-check job
why_recommended: One source of truth; the reconciliation script becomes a one-line diff instead of a 32-row audit.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Consensus on who owns the file (shared-output rule)

title: Force every club reference through a published club-id map
problem_it_solves: Standings and schedule pages write LA; the injury report writes LAR for the same club. Silent join failures follow.
option_a: club_id.csv with abbr, alt, slug; checker rejects unmapped values
why_recommended: Cheap and prevents a class of error that has already occurred in prior registers.

title: Add a one-screen 'decision sheet' per slate: our line, blank market, gate state, next unlock
problem_it_solves: Reviewers must read five pages to decide whether to act on a slate.
option_a: Generated slate decision sheet linking out to detail pages
why_recommended: Matches how the user actually decides: one game, one row, one action; also makes the blanks conspicuous.

title: Fail CI when any published page's read_date predates the last completed game day
problem_it_solves: A page can look authoritative while being a week stale; the drift we documented took 24 hours to appear.
option_a: Compute the last finished game from the schedule read and compare
why_recommended: Turns a documented real failure into an automated stop; option B is cosmetic.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Requires the snapshot job (SUG-03) to know game dates reliably

title: Add .gitattributes and normalise line endings; add a root licence file or explicit no-licence statement
problem_it_solves: 31 CSV files carry CRLF (a prior audit counted 16, an undercount) and the repo has no LICENSE, so reuse terms are undefined.
option_a: Normalize EOL in one commit + .gitattributes; add LICENSE or RIGHTS.md
option_b: Leave CRLF, add a checker that ignores it
why_recommended: One mechanical commit removes diff noise permanently; the licence decision is the owner's, so publish a placeholder question.

title: Reconcile the six open PRs whose head branches no longer exist
problem_it_solves: Open PRs #48, #52, #54, #56, #68, #72 look actionable but their branches are gone; #68 in particular duplicates NFL work.
option_a: Close each with a comment linking the merged successor
option_b: Rebase and merge the still-useful ones (#68 content review)
why_recommended: One of them (#68) contains a parallel NFL pack whose registers may hold values not present anywhere on main; reviewing it before closing is the only irreversible-risk item.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Owner decision on whether to import #68 registers

title: Add an explicit 'MODEL ASSUMPTION' style class so assumptions never look like facts
problem_it_solves: Assumption cells (variance, HFA points, weights) sit next to verified cells in the same visual language.
option_a: CSS class + checker rule: assumption cells must carry the label
option_c: Move all assumptions to a separate page
why_recommended: Preserves the single-table readability while making the boundary machine-checkable.

title: Buy nothing: compute margin SD and key-number mass from the official weekly scores pages first
problem_it_solves: The pack's biggest missing inputs (margin SD, key-number frequency) are computable from public official pages at the cost of 18 page reads.
option_a: Fetch 2025 weekly scores pages, store margins, publish measured SD and key-number mass
why_recommended: Converts the most load-bearing assumption into a measured value, and it is the only gate (DG-16-adjacent) unlockable this week.
prerequisites_before_implementing: Owner approval for the 18 additional page reads

title: Publish the 'what would move you up' column next to every strategy row
problem_it_solves: A strategy list with 0/16 gates tells the owner nothing actionable.
option_a: Per-strategy unlock list generated from gate state
option_b: Leave gates on a separate page
option_c: Remove the board until data exists
why_recommended: Turns the leaderboard into a work queue; option C would discard the pre-registration value.

title: State the responsible-gambling resource on the NFL landing page, not only on the NBA footer
problem_it_solves: The footer helpline number was verified against an official regulator page but appears only on the NBA landing.
option_a: Repeat the verified line on every domain landing
why_recommended: Keeps the verified regulator text where a reader arriving directly would otherwise never see it.
prerequisites_before_implementing: None - the text is already source-verified
